scope.rust_configuration: All cfg/cfg_attr attribute text, including module/file capability gates; no cfg evaluation.
scope.python: Module/class test* functions in repository test_*.py sources, including decorators.

scope.limitations: Source inventory only: no Rust macro expansion/cfg resolution, generated tests, runtime discovery or execution claim.
